title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: Let players teach
hook: What happens when a ten-year-old explains a drill?
intro: One player has the skill down.
statement: Teaching a skill is another way to learn it.
q1: Do you pair players so one can teach the other —
q2: or keep the teaching to the coaches?
t1: There is no single right way. But confidence grows
t2: when a player gets to share what they know.
ctaLines: Buddy pairs. Show the group. Explain it back.
ctaPrompt: Share your teaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What happens when a ten-year-old explains a drill?
One player has the skill down. A teammate is still struggling.
Teaching a skill is another way to learn it.
Let players teach or keep it with coaches. There is no single right way.
Do players ever teach? Share your habit in the comments.
